en: The image shows a postcard reproduction of a large mural or altarpiece framed by a pointed Gothic arch with pinkish ribs and ornate golden borders. The painting depicts a medieval or early‑Christian royal figure in rich robes and crown, holding a processional banner topped with a cross and laurel, surrounded by warriors. One kneels before him with outstretched hands, while another stands with a round shield and sword; discarded armor and weapons lie on the ground. In the background are additional soldiers and a landscape. A Latin inscription runs along the bottom in a decorative golden frame.
